'''Tal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Tal, along with [[Laria Taphoni]] and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gatten Edaine]], was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and worked for the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]. He participated in the expedition that was assigned to work with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Tykan]] to investigate the desolated swampland populated by [[rakghoul]]s. However, when most members of the expedition was killed with the exception of Tykan himself and a survey team, who had left before the attack, Laria and Tal were trapped under a large piece of debris before a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Knight]] arrived. The Jedi levitated Tal back to safety.
